title: Akai Katana
note: Shoot'em up by Cave (CV1000): no value known yet. Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CV1000 SH-3 RAM from 0xC000000, the first 8 MB of its 8, as far as the values of the game go, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, one digit per byte (RetroAchievements leaderboard "High Score Heroes" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, one digit per byte (RetroAchievements leaderboard "High Score Heroes" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
